description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Applications' headline figure in the
Development section.

Count of development applications in the last 5 years, one per site address, in the dwelling, subdivision, aged-care, education, industrial and utilities categories. `/development/applications` lists every category so its total is larger.

**Price: 6¢ per call.**
